title: 第23章 无始 爹娘你们没死啊第24章 我帮我娘追我爹的日常生活
slug: 遮天刚成天帝聊天群什么鬼
content_zh:
瑶池圣地。
最深处的一片仙池净土。
淡淡的仙气从池中升腾而起。
少年呆呆的坐在原地，他的身旁是一堆破碎的神源，仙泪绿金塔在他的头顶微微颤抖着，一缕缕温和的气息轻轻的抚在他的身上……
小无始的眼神有些悲哀。
这种一朝苏醒，举目无亲的感觉实在是太让人沉重了，他如今也才七八岁而已。
小小年纪。
便要忍受丧亲之痛。
哪怕他再怎么早慧懂事。
此刻也忍不住心中微微颤抖。
“爹、娘…”
“你们说过要一直陪着我的。”
小无始有些悲哀的轻声低语道。
他在脑海中回忆着曾经与父母一起渡过的美好时光，再看着眼前一片孤寂的瑶池，只感觉到了一股浓浓的悲哀。
那种让人窒息的感觉将他吞没。
仿佛要拉入深渊一般。
很难想象。
他究竟是怎么扛下去的。
“嗡！”
就在这时。

头顶的仙泪绿金塔轻轻颤抖。
只见一名神女从塔中走出，她身着一袭华丽的长裙，身姿婀娜，肌肤白腻，容颜绝世。
与曾经的那位西皇一般无二。
小无始怔怔的看着眼前的神女。
他沉默了片刻后，道：
“你不是母亲。”
“嗯。”
神女微微颔首。
她是仙泪绿金塔的神祇，虽说不是西皇本人，但也可以看作是西皇在此界的另类延续了。
“爹、娘他们究竟去了哪里？”
小无始沉默道。
闻言。
帝兵神祇微微沉吟：“大帝与人皇已经不在世间了。”
她的意思是——
大帝与人皇已经不在人间宇宙了。
但小无始似乎理解错了意思，他颤抖的看着眼前的帝兵神祇，眼底流露出了一抹浓浓的悲哀……
爹娘已经死了吗？
不！
他不允许！
他绝对不允许！

世上一定有办法复活他人！
他要将父亲与母亲复活！他要创造一个有父母的世界！
——无始欲复活双亲！
帝兵神祇看出小无始似乎理解错了意思，但她没有解释，似乎也想小无始能够有些动力：
“你有着史上最强的天赋与体质。”
content_en:
Yaochi Holy Land.
The deepest piece of fairy pond pure land.
A faint fairy spirit rises from the pool.
The young man sat there blankly. Next to him was a pile of broken divine sources. The Green Golden Tower of Immortal Tears was trembling slightly above his head, and wisps of gentle breath gently caressed his body...
Xiao Wushi's eyes were a little sad.
This feeling of being without a friend once he wakes up is really too heavy. He is only seven or eight years old now.
At a young age.
They have to endure the pain of bereavement.
No matter how precocious and sensible he is.
At this moment, I couldn't help but feel a little trembling in my heart.
"Father, mother..."
"You said you would always stay with me."
Xiao Wushi whispered sadly.
He recalled the good times he had spent with his parents in his mind, and then looked at the lonely Yaochi in front of him, and felt a deep sadness.
The suffocating feeling swallowed him up.
It seemed like it was being pulled into an abyss.
It's hard to imagine.
How on earth did he carry it on?
"Buzz!"
Just then.
The green golden tower of fairy tears above the head trembled slightly.
I saw a goddess walking out of the tower. She was wearing a gorgeous long dress, with a graceful figure, white skin, and a peerless appearance.
He is no different from the former Western Emperor.
Xiao Wushi stared blankly at the goddess in front of him.
After being silent for a moment, he said:
"You are not a mother."
"Yeah."
The goddess nodded slightly.
She is the deity of the Immortal Tears Green Golden Pagoda. Although she is not the Western Emperor himself, she can be regarded as an alternative continuation of the Western Emperor in this world.
"Where did Mom and Dad go?"
Xiao Wushi said silently.
Hear the words.
The Emperor Weapon God muttered slightly: "The Great Emperor and the Human Emperor are no longer in this world."
What she means is——
The Great Emperor and the Human Emperor are no longer in the human universe.
But Xiao Wushi seemed to have misunderstood the meaning. He tremblingly looked at the imperial weapon gods in front of him, with a deep sadness in his eyes...
Are your parents dead?
No!
He doesn't allow it!
He will never allow it!
There must be a way to resurrect others!
He will resurrect father and mother! He wants to create a world with parents!
——Wu Shi wants to resurrect his parents!
The Imperial Soldier God saw that Xiao Wushi seemed to have misunderstood the meaning, but she did not explain, and seemed to want Xiao Wushi to have some motivation:
"You have the strongest talent and physique in history."
